rows.definition: Pointer-to-uint64 v3 receipt witness field counting the GPU kernels launched during the measured window, part of the host-overhead decomposition.
rows.distinction: A counted witness on one receipt, not the InterKernelGapSumUs gap metric beside it and not the coordinator kernel concept the family root names.

rows.definition: uint64 AQL/HSA dispatch-packet field holding the GPU virtual address of the kernel code object or descriptor being dispatched.
rows.distinction: An address slot inside a dispatch packet, not a kernel decision ledger, not a Windows live-kernel fault event, and not the coordinator kernel concept.

rows.definition: String axis of the fitplan CalibrationKey identifying which kernel path a bandwidth or calibration row was measured under.
rows.distinction: A calibration-row identity axis, not a kernel timing-delta metric and not the coordinator kernel concept.

rows.definition: compute-package function returning the per-kernel work accumulated between two cumulative KernelProfile snapshots, joined by revision.
rows.distinction: The difference of two snapshots, not the snapshot read itself and not the reader-registration predicate.

rows.definition: compute-package predicate reporting whether a kernel profile reader is currently registered in the process-wide reader slot.
rows.distinction: A registration probe, not the cumulative snapshot read and not the delta join between two snapshots.

rows.definition: compute-package function reading the registered backend's cumulative kernel profile, returning nil when no reader is registered.
rows.distinction: A point-in-time cumulative read, not the delta between two reads and not the registration probe.

rows.definition: cmd/fak serve load helper performing the placed in-kernel model load while returning errors plus the memory plan it planned against instead of exiting via must().
rows.distinction: The error-returning twin driven by the two-phase fit-commit back-off, not the fatal-must loadServeInKernelModelPlaced it wraps.

rows.definition: Research design term for compiling an entire LLM forward pass into one persistent GPU kernel, as analyzed in the Metal fused-decode study for Qwen3.6-27B.
rows.distinction: A whole-model fused-kernel architecture idea from a research note, not a concrete launchable kernel struct such as the Wave32 GEMV decode kernel, and not the coordinator kernel concept.

rows.definition: cgo-bound Metal projection-graph entry point that pins which P=1 GEMV kernel mode the graph encodes, called from ProjectionGraph.SetGEMVKernel before first encode.
rows.distinction: The C-side pinning call for one Metal graph, not the Go GEMVKernelSet selector and receipt vocabulary it serves.

rows.definition: tb4bench constructor returning a Docker/Podman daemon client bound to a Unix socket or Windows named pipe for sandboxed benchmark runs.
rows.distinction: A container-daemon client constructor for tb4bench sandboxes, not a model-serving engine adapter such as NewVLLMEngine, and not the engine dispatch-seam concept.

rows.definition: cmd/fak constructor building the turnkey fak-up InKernelPlanner with resolved KV precision, derived compact-history budget, batch decode and the Halo device-execution requirement.
rows.distinction: The turnkey planner factory used by fak up, not the configured in-kernel planner construction seam positioned for the gateway planner binding.

rows.definition: nativeperf.Phase constant kernel marking the exclusive GPU-kernel-execution slice of a request's decode host-work timeline.
rows.distinction: A per-request native performance phase label, not the subagent-trace gpu_kernel bucket and not the coordinator kernel concept.

rows.definition: Receipt and campaign field recording which Qwen3.8 engine (MTP or target-decode) ran as primary in a shadow or fan-out trial.
rows.distinction: A recorded role label on a receipt, not the engine type it stores and not the resolved effective-engine label of the all-in-one view.

rows.definition: compute-package mapper turning a Qwen3.5 GDN CUDA status code into the named failure stage from preflight through output-projection carried by Qwen35GDNKernelError.
rows.distinction: The stage-label derivation for GDN kernel errors, not the error type itself and not a kernel phase label.

rows.definition: Qwen38MTPEngine constant fak-native-qwen3.8-mtp naming the speculative multi-token-prediction execution path for Qwen3.8 requests.
rows.distinction: One closed enum value of the Qwen38MTPEngine type, not the type itself, not its target-decode sibling value, and not the validity predicate over the values.

rows.definition: Qwen38MTPEngine constant fak-native-qwen3.8-target-decode naming the non-speculative target-model-only decode path for Qwen3.8.
rows.distinction: The fallback and target-only enum value, not the MTP speculative value, not the engine type, and not the generic fak-native verification engine label.

rows.definition: String type identifying the fak-native execution path selected for a Qwen3.8 request, with closed values Qwen38EngineMTP and Qwen38EngineTargetDecode.
rows.distinction: The engine-identity type, not either of its two constant values and not the validQwen38MTPEngine closed-set predicate.

rows.definition: Optional compute.Backend capability interface whose implementations serve routed-expert FP8/MXFP4 GEMVs natively on the device, failing closed with ErrExpertDeviceKernelAbsent when absent.
rows.distinction: A device capability interface for expert GEMVs, not the host-side P=1 GEMV kernel selector and receipt set and not a concrete kernel symbol.

rows.definition: fak-dev command handler implementing the kernel-oracle verb, joining llama.cpp test-backend-ops perf rows with fak Vulkan kernel timings at matching op, dtype and shape.
rows.distinction: The external-oracle comparison command, not the SelectedKernels ledger rows it consumes and not the coordinator kernel concept.

rows.definition: Strix validation option flag requesting that the selected subkernels be executed and parity-checked during amd-strix-validate runs.
rows.distinction: The run-the-list switch, not the subkernel parity unit itself and not the Subkernels selection list it gates.

rows.definition: NativeKernels ledger field holding the smallest prefix of per-kernel GPU-time rows whose share reaches the selected-coverage target, followed by one KernelOther row.
rows.distinction: A bounded summary of which kernels a native decode spent time in, not the kernel-oracle command that reads it and not raw kernel counters.

rows.definition: amd64-only AVX-512 assembly stream-copy routine with store-only and load-only companions, used by the Strix weight-streaming path and gated by a physical CPUID check.
rows.distinction: A host-CPU memcpy optimization kernel, not a GPU decode GEMV kernel and not the coordinator kernel concept.

rows.definition: SubagentTraceSchema phase-bucket constant gpu_kernel attributing subagent execution time to raw GPU kernel work in the subagent timing decomposition.
rows.distinction: A subagent-trace attribution bucket, not the per-request nativeperf PhaseKernel phase label and not a concrete kernel symbol.

rows.definition: One named Strix op-level parity unit such as qwen35-embedding-gather, qwen35-sequence-kv or qwen35-partial-rope, validated against a typed oracle during amd-strix subkernel runs.
rows.distinction: The singular parity unit, not the plural Subkernels selection and result lists and not the RunSubkernels switch that triggers them.

rows.definition: Strix validation fields naming which subkernels were selected (option list) and how each parity-checked (receipt results).
rows.distinction: The plural selection and result lists, not one subkernel parity unit and not the RunSubkernels boolean gate.

rows.definition: model-package constant fak-native stamped as the Engine label on verification receipts across the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 verification paths.
rows.distinction: The generic fak-native engine label on verification receipts, not the Qwen3.8 target-decode enum value it sits beside and not the engine dispatch-seam concept.

rows.definition: model-package closed-set predicate accepting exactly the Qwen38MTPEngine values Qwen38EngineMTP and Qwen38EngineTargetDecode, enforced by Qwen38MTP receipt validation.
rows.distinction: The value-domain guard, not the engine type it guards and not either engine value.

rows.definition: gfx1151 Wave32 Q2_K decode GEMV struct owning the physical launch shape and the fail-closed admission gate that refuses dispatch without a validated hsaco/AQL launch proof instead of degrading to CPU.
rows.distinction: A concrete GPU decode GEMV kernel with an admission gate, not the host-side P=1 GEMV selector set and not the research megakernel idea.
